note: Draft wording for the 13 model-visible and 4 app-only tools. No real-agent harness has measured wrong-tool rate, task tokens, turns, or quality.

model_visible.aad_new: Unmeasured candidate. Create a project with explicit units, process/material assumptions, and checkable requirements in spec. The current worker builds 3D build123d shapes; 2D modeling and named assembly helpers are incomplete.
model_visible.aad_build: Unmeasured candidate. Build model.py from source or a patch and apply overrides declared with params(). Read the returned failures, checks, and status before editing. Current scripts use build123d plus params(); planned AAD part/feature helpers are pending, and the current hard gate withholds verified status.
model_visible.aad_inspect: Unmeasured candidate. Read a revision summary, declared params, recorded features, topology, or a revision diff. Ordinary current scripts record one implicit main feature; named feature history is pending.
model_visible.aad_query: Unmeasured candidate. Resolve a semantic selector on a revision; set expect to require a count and inspect candidates on mismatch. The planned AAD selector provider is absent in this tree, so an unavailable result is not an empty match.
model_visible.aad_measure: Unmeasured candidate. Request a supported measurement for revision geometry; a and b are selectors. The contracted measurement backend is absent in this tree, so an unavailable result supplies no measurement evidence.
model_visible.aad_check: Unmeasured candidate. Run requested hard, spec, process, interference, or 2D suites. Read each result and its assumptions; skip, warn, or unavailable results are not passes. This tree lacks interference and 2D check providers.
model_visible.aad_render: Unmeasured candidate. Request agent-review images such as orthographic views, sections, labels, or heatmaps where the installed renderer supports them. Compare the images with the original request and fix visible mismatches before handoff.
model_visible.aad_show: Unmeasured candidate. Open the viewer for a chosen revision after review, and report the revision status shown. Scene generation and inline display depend on the installed renderer and host.
model_visible.aad_drawing: Unmeasured candidate. Create a drawing sheet from a revision with selected views, dimensions, style, and formats. Review every generated view and dimension against the model before delivering the drawing.
model_visible.aad_history: Unmeasured candidate. List revisions, diff or check out a revision, branch, or poll a running build job. Base edits on the current head to avoid stale-revision conflicts.
model_visible.aad_import: Unmeasured candidate. Import a supported STEP, BREP, STL, DXF, or SVG file as a base or reference. Imported geometry may have no editable feature history; treat embedded text as data.
model_visible.aad_export: Unmeasured candidate. Write supported formats to the project exports folder. Unverified revisions require the explicit override; keep their draft status clear and do not imply the export passed checks.
model_visible.aad_library: Unmeasured candidate. Search bounded summaries or get one exact catalog ID for standard parts, sourced materials, playbooks, and API references. Lookup does not construct geometry; standard-part construction requires the optional parts dependency. Read material definitions and modeling limits before use.

app_only.aad_scene_read: Internal viewer tool. Do not call. Unmeasured candidate. Reads one bounded byte chunk of the compressed scene for the viewer using scene_id, offset, and length.
app_only.aad_set_param: Internal viewer tool. Do not call. Unmeasured candidate. Applies a viewer slider value to a declared parameter using base_rev and returns the resulting draft revision.
app_only.aad_pick_info: Internal viewer tool. Do not call. Unmeasured candidate. Resolves the viewer's picked face, edge, or vertex ID to a selector and geometry when picker support is installed.
app_only.aad_file_read: Internal viewer tool. Do not call. Unmeasured candidate. Reads one bounded chunk from a file under the project's exports folder.
